lessons.title: Getting started – Go Green Club
objectives: Gain an overview of the topic 'Humans and the environment';
Understand and use vocabulary to talk about activities to adopt a greener lifestyle;
Identify the use of future forms (will vs. be going to) and the passive voice in context.
Core Competences:
Develop communication skills and environmental awareness;
Be collaborative and supportive in pair work and teamwork;
Actively join in class activities.
Personal Qualities:
Develop a greener lifestyle and active awareness of environmental issues;
Demonstrate responsibility toward the community and the natural environment.
Digital & AI Competences:
3: Use AI tools and search engines to collect and summarize information about Go Green Club activities and eco-friendly practices.
2: Maintain human oversight and critical verification when evaluating digital environmental data from online sources.

lessons.title: Language – Pronunciation /cl/, /pl/, /gr/, /pr/ & Future with will vs. be going to
lessons.short_title: Pronunciation /cl/, /pl/, /gr/, /pr/ & Future with will vs. be going to
objectives: Pronounce consonant blends /kl/, /pl/, /gr/, and /pr/ correctly in isolation and in connected sentences;
Understand and use lexical items related to humans and the environment;

Form and use the passive voice correctly.
Core Competences:
Develop phonetic discrimination, grammatical precision, and communicative fluency;
Work collaboratively in pairs and groups.
Personal Qualities:
Foster a green mindset and responsibility for environmental protection;
Cultivate self-study habits.

3: Use AI tools, digital dictionaries, and pronunciation applications to look up word definitions and phonetic blends.

Structure and write a coherent 120–150 word paragraph suggesting ways to improve the local/school environment using connectors (First, Second, For example, In conclusion).

1: Comply with copyright regulations and intellectual property rules when citing digital environmental sources.
